entities.summary: The Face is a British quarterly youth culture magazine. It began publication in 1980 from London, founded by Nick Logan. Ceasing publication in 2004 due to dwindling circulation, the magazine was revived in 2019 by Wasted Talent. In 2026, it was announced that the magazine would cease publication within the year.
